comment: Regex fragments that make a catalogue meal unsuitable for a dietary preference, matched case-insensitively against title and detail. One bilingual list because the recommendation engine and the catalogue validator must agree, and because both catalogues describe the same 200 meals. Matching is by substring so German compounds work (Hüttenkäse, Joghurtdip); the few English words that would collide with unrelated ones carry their own word boundaries. Parmesan, feta and tzatziki were missing from the original list: none contains the word 'Käse', so a lactose-free user was offered all three. Pesto and Caesar dressing were missing for the same reason: both are built on parmesan.
